Cabot Wealth Management Inc sold 2,737 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 60,093 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.40M, down from 62,830 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cabot Wealth Management Inc who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $337.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.48% or $0.6 $125.73. About 1.52M shares traded. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has risen 1.12% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.43% the S&P500.
John Ku decreased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 4.66% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
